notes.title: Coming features
notes.content: [p]Hey, [/p][p]I know I´ve gone for a bit of a radio silence for a while, but I´m still working on the game every day. I´m just currently working on features that just need a bit of time in the oven. The next update will most likely drop a day or two before 11/1, just in time for the animal fest, altough I´m thinking about splitting it into two smaller updates, as it´s practically two separate areas of the game. [/p][p]Features to come then include:[/p][p]1) Adding two more videogames to the arcades, making the cabinets all fully interactible. Apart from the really simple rebound game which is already playable right now, you will be able to play "Omniwar", an on-rails shooter, and "Kabuto garden", a samurai-themed action platformer. Playing these games will contribute to levelling up your DEX stat.[/p][p]2) Beefing up the casino. Instead of one, there´s three rows now, and the prizes account for your streak, bonuses, etc. The UI and sound design has been heavily rworked to be more snappy and immediate. The balancing has also improved, as the current version of the casino is actually lucrative once you come to the slots with enough money to begin with, (it currently breaks at 1000P).[/p][p]3) Adding a new path to the Fortress of Frog so you can rescue imprisoned friends early-game, without having to unlock the OG port from the second overworld map.[/p][p]4) Adding simple quests for NPCs that already are in the game, as well as adding new NPCs. This is currently the only thing I do not yet have finished, that´s why I´m thinking about splitting the update. There´s also going to be a really complicated murder mystery quest, which I´m really nervous about finishing in time as it requires two brand new NPCs complete with voice acting etc.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Here is a few screenshots:[/p][p]Kabuto garden gameplay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/bfc1c083a853fe7a9c97be711e2fdda41e129e9a.png"][/img]Omniwar gameplay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/9a703ed1853b1312d4f118a9cfbc5229fef4bc9e.png"][/img]new area leading to the fortress of frog[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/c6bc64e7143660f98ba5dd9138286a537b5c1ce7.png"][/img][/p][p]Well, that´s all for now from me![/p][p]What about you? Will you avenge general Nejedlý? Go! Go! Go![/p]

notes.title: Newly fixed bugs
notes.content: [p]Hey, [/p][p]the new update fixed a few arbitrary and boring bugs. You might also notice a few things having changed around, this is in preparation for a larger content update.[/p][p][/p][p]"Ponder" before beginning a new game would softlock you and you would have to delete a non-existing character in order to play the game. This is now fixed, and a warning of the ponder menu not contributing to your progress when you have not created a character has been added.[/p][p]Dialog with dr Cedrovnik will not be triggered outside of the clinic now.[/p][p]You are now able to buy Pink Fratre´s wares, an option I forgot to put in for that character.[/p][p]Maťka is now less likely to ruin your game and can not spawn if you have less than 88 money. This was not a bug, but the game is more playable like this.[/p][p]Christopher Landslide can now massage you outside of the asylum.[/p][p]The Foram Fortress boss can now not spawn twice.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/1a8f2e39c7448de5a58845a4f7cde2e7a38d609b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being with me on my quest of making this game astounding and incredible. Now go out there, and avenge general Nejedlý´s death![/p][p]Strejda Jenda Productions[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Armed Animals RPG - RELEASE!
notes.content: [p]Hey, [/p][p]so I´ve finally released my game, a project I have spent the majority of my free time for the last two years. As much as this is an even to me, this does not mean I will stop working on the game, far from it, I´m going to polish cosmetic stuff, fix bugs, and add new features and content. [/p][p][/p][p]So... What can you expect from the game as is right now? [/p][p]Well, there´s a lot. [/p][p]•The game has a main quest with five completely different achievable endings, and a few more secret endings are yet to come. [/p][p]•The game boasts a full arsenal of weapons, from dimpy antique revolvers, through heavy aircraft machineguns to weird sci-fi inventions of the animal civilisation. [/p][p]•The game is fully voice acted, you can talk to civillians and unique NPCs alike (and sometimes to enemies too!)[/p][p]•Lots of side-quests and side activities, you can work out in the famous Ostružina´s gym, play videogames in the librar- ehm I mean arcades (some of which are to come), and just go explore and find friends or enemies. [/p][p]•A very in-depth health system relying on YOU to diagnose and find the cure. No "you have low blood iron" signs or meter flickers or beeps here - you need to watch out for your character yourself, and watch him closely.[/p][p]•A gradually more and more populated bunker, as you free prisoners or make other rebellious animals join you.[/p][p][/p][p]So go out there, and avenge general Nejedlý[b]’[/b]s death! Flosscat needs to pay![/p][p]Your [/p][p]Strejda Jenda Productions[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/901f12ea62f8913b4978f95be8e498de3d13ab4c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major Content added
notes.content: [p]Hey! Added some major content to the game, as it nears release. Worked on the "Ponder" menu[/p][p]a lot, adding three ponder points total as well as patching the two first tutorials and the mistakes[/p][p]present there-in. [/p][p][/p][p]So now, apart from explaining and teaching the game, the Ponder menu also tells the game´s [/p][p]backstory by letting you play through it´s main events through the eyes of major P.P.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, a whole bunch of quest log notes have been added, including some clues to more intricate[/p][p]side-quests and major P.P.´s commentary on some of the things he´s told by NPCs. Also enjoy [/p][p]one of my drafts of major P.P. for the cutscenes below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/884559c97351493d9dcf53a5610a3faca7ff4ae7.png"][/img][/p][p]Until later,[/p][p]Strejda Jenda productions.[/p]

notes.title: Patch + ponder point update
notes.content: [p]Patched the bug that made the wrong NPC talk upon talking to an NPC. This would also cause multiple NPCs to talk over each other, because I´m an idiot and I did not understando how the code o my own game works, which I have learned since.[/p][p]Also added a cutscene of general Nejedlý in the "Ponder" menu. It´s still WIP, especially regarding captain Flosscat´s voice acting and audio balancing. Watching it will allow for stuff in future updates that´s not there yet.[/p]
